ObjectStates.Name: CardCustom
ObjectStates.Description: When you play a "chorus" card, resolve the regular effect as normal. Then, leave the card face up in front of you instead of discarding it. At the end of your turn, you resolve all chorus effects and discard them.Chorus cards will always be discarded at the end of your turn, even if their effects are unable to resolve. If the effect is placed face-up on an opponent's turn, it is only discarded at the end of your next turn.Heroes can have multiple Chorus cards at once. If multiple Chorus cards would resolve at once, you choose the order in which they resolve.
